hypotheses: A free tier protects demand against a rival price cut. Proposed test threshold: at least 15% of visitors sign up for the free tier.
Students will pay S$9 for StudyFlow. Proposed test threshold: at least 8% of 100+ landing-page visitors join the waitlist at S$9.
S$9 sits below the 'getting expensive' point for target students. Proposed test threshold: at least 40% of 50+ survey respondents agree.
Free Planner users will switch for better AI planning. Proposed test threshold: at least 3 of 5 interviewed users describe a recent planning failure.
Opted-in study groups respond to an early-access offer. Proposed test threshold: at least 10% of subscribers tap 'Get early access' within 7 days.

assets.landing_copy:
# StudyFlow: an exam plan that rewrites itself when your week changes

Tell it your modules and deadlines. It builds the plan and adjusts it every evening.

## Why switch
- Builds a revision plan from your module deadlines in two minutes.
- Re-plans automatically when you miss a session, no guilt spiral.
- Your notes stay private; nothing is shared with your school.
- Syncs with the calendar you already use.

## Price positioning to test (proposed variants)
- Variant A: S$9/month, cancel any time.
- Variant B: S$7.20/month for students who join the waitlist this month.
- Variant C: free planner, S$9/month for AI re-planning.

interview_script: Screen: full-time student with at least one exam this term; not on the founding team or a close friend.
Tell me about the last time a deadline crept up on you. What happened?
How did you plan that week? Show me the tool or notes if you can.
What did you try to fix it afterwards? What did that cost you?
Which apps do you pay for today, and what made them worth it?
If a tool re-planned your week every evening, what would you expect to pay? (do not suggest a number)
What would make you stop using Free Planner tomorrow?
Close: may we invite you to test StudyFlow? (record consent)

tracking_plan.decision_rule: Keep S$9 if the landing test and the price-ladder survey both meet their proposed thresholds. If only S$7.20 passes, test a free tier plus paid AI upgrade next. If neither passes, revisit the target segment before changing the product.
